title: The Last Collection Is an Operational Event
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Last Collection Is an Operational Event: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A final collection is an operational event: orders, staff, collaborators, IP, files, samples, money, promises, and public language require decisions even when creative work stops.
frames.alt: Title plate for The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: Made after Charles Frederick Worth’s death, the dress lets the house name continue in the record without proving who controlled every creative or economic decision.
frames.credit: Gift of Miss Eva Drexel Dahlgren, 1976
frames.alt: House of Worth silk evening dress from 1898 to 1900 with a pale embellished bodice, narrow waist, and richly patterned trained skirt.
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · STABILIZE — Who and what need an answer today?. Inventory safety, payroll, benefits, contractors, customers, deposits, deadlines, facilities, systems, insurers, lenders, and emergency contacts. Identify the authorized interim decision-maker from actual records.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who and what need an answer today? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · FREEZE — Which changes should stop?. Preserve files, samples, accounts, logs, agreements, permissions, money movements, and public drafts; suspend deletion and irreversible publication while legal holds, privacy, and access are reviewed.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping which changes should stop? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · DECIDE — Can unfinished work continue?. Assess creative authority, contributor consent, labor, contract, quality, finance, rights, customer, cultural, and reputational consequences for ship, pause, complete, transfer, or cancel.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can unfinished work continue? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · ACCOUNT — How will the institution explain the outcome?. Publish only verified decisions, preserve dissent and credits, notify affected parties before spectacle, record refunds or remedies, and archive the rationale and authority.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how will the institution explain the outcome? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Completing a founder’s last work can honor relationships or exploit absence. Stopping can protect integrity or harm workers and customers. There is no universal sentimental answer; authority, obligations, evidence, and participant voice must govern.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery
